name: Candlestick Point SRA
description: Candlestick Point State Recreation Area in San Francisco's Bayview/Hunters Point neighborhood was California's first urban state park, with shoreline trails, picnic areas, a public fishing pier, and free community programs.
fullDescription: Candlestick Point State Recreation Area in San Francisco's Bayview/Hunters Point neighborhood was California's first urban state park, with shoreline trails, picnic areas, a public fishing pier, and free community programs.
whatTheyOffer:
- Accessible walking and biking trails along the bay
- Picnic areas with BBQ grills, including four group sites (first come, first served)
- Public fishing pier (no fishing license needed on the pier)
- Kayaking, windsurfing, swimming, and bird watching
- Free arts and nature programs; volunteer days the first Saturday of each month
- Sunrise Point group campground (6 sites for groups of 20-40, $35/site per night; arrange with the park manager)
- Dogs allowed on a 6-foot leash; phone (415) 798-7318
howToGetIt:
California State Parks does not list a day-use fee for this park. Park hours are listed as 7 am-7 pm (sunrise to sunset).

**Getting there:** Main entrance at 500 Hunters Point Expressway. From Highway 101, take the Third Street exit, turn right on Gilman Avenue, and continue to the park entrance.
address: 500 Hunters Point Expressway, San Francisco, CA, 94124
